anomalies.observed: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet the BMI088 chip-select pin CSB2 (pin 8) is wired to NET0002, the same net that carries the I2C clock (SCL) to every other NAVC-side I2C device (IIS2MDCTR pin 1, TMP100 pin 1, MPRLS0025 pin 2, 24CW1280 pin 1). CSB1 (pin 14) and PS (pin 7) are correctly tied to +3.3V, but CSB2 is not.
anomalies.expected: For I2C operation (which the specification states: 'Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)') both CSB1 and CSB2 must be held at VDDIO/+3.3V. Tying CSB2 to the SCL line means the clock edge toggles the SPI chip-select input, taking the device out of a stable I2C state and corrupting/aborted transfers.

anomalies.impact: The IMU would not reliably communicate on the I2C bus; accelerometer/gyroscope data (the core navigation input) could be missing or garbled, contradicting the documented I2C addressing.

parsed.summary: Most of the build matches the specification (correct MCUs, sensors, regulators, addresses and passive values, with the only documented bug — the barometer RESET/EOC swap — present and excluded). One deviation is visible: the BMI088 CSB2 pin is tied to the I2C SCL net (NET0002) instead of +3.3V, which is inconsistent with the intended I2C operation of the IMU.
